outcomes: The Cloud CLI reports a published archive member only after Put accepted it, and the member names the archive by ecosystem and coordinate
nonGoals: Storing the member or moving a channel. The release-set provider owns both
Validating the archive on the server. Put validates the upload and the manifest when it accepts them

requirements.text: `publish-archives` uploads each archive, then publishes the version without a channel. It emits one published-member event only after Put accepted both requests. The member is keyed by the archive ecosystem and the package coordinate, and carries the version, the artifact digest and one digest per platform, so it passes the published-member validation and matches the member the release plan declared.
